replies.author: Riilo
replies.body:
Also I would like to state the changes Komodo, Alpp and I made.
- Made an ACTUAL  center block. (Rilo)
- Added clay roof (Alpp)
- Made there 2 monuments, not 4. (Rilo)
- Made middle shorter (Thanks Distraction for suggestion) (Rilo)
- Added trees, leaves and water (Rilo)
- Fixed spawn so it was 1 block, not 2 (Rilo)
- Added a fountain (Might remove) (Alpp and Rilo)
- Made an extra 2 sets of stairs (Komodo, Alpp and Rilo)
- Made a bridge to middle (Komodo, Alpp, Rilo)
- Added parkour on the sides (Alpp and Komodo)
- Fixed ground pattern so it wasn't bump (Rilo)
